title: I built a Blender addon that makes Claude 2x faster at using nodes, and cuts down on mistakes
author: ctkrocks
selftext:
4 years ago I made this addon called [Geometry Script](https://github.com/carson-katri/geometry-script) that added a scripting API for Blender's node trees.

I tried it with Claude recently and discovered that its about twice as fast and token efficient when compared with regular Blender Python scripts to build node trees.

The API in Geometry Script gives more structure to building node trees in Blender, so Claude makes less mistakes that need to be noticed and corrected. It also makes it easier for Claude to tweak the node trees by making targeted changes to a well-typed script, instead of trying to explore how node sockets are connected with one-off probing Python scripts.

It works for all nodes in Blender (geometry nodes, shader nodes, etc.)

Give it a try and let me know how it works for you!
